title: Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures

result.label: Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures
result.statement: Proves a dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for centered log-concave densities with uniformly subgaussian linear marginals, with constant bounded by a universal multiple of the squared linear subgaussian parameter.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
